objective: Move ordinary Quest reminder execution into Ron System/PWA with server-side persisted schedules and Web Push delivery, while preserving Timing v2 semantics and making transport failures diagnosable.

roles_before.artifact: Neon/PostgreSQL system_events owns mutable derived RPG/System state.
TIMING_PRESSURE_SPEC.md / system-timing:v2 owns deadlines and recommended-window semantics.
push-delivery.mjs + system_push_subscriptions/system_push_deliveries deliver notification.pushed events to subscribed PWA devices.
deadline-engine.mjs owns hard-deadline expiry and existing deadline/recommended-window notification generation.
sw-v2.js receives Web Push and renders OS notifications.
ChatGPT task automations are not canonical Ron System player-state owners.
Git history and prior deadline/push architecture remain recoverable.
system-cloud-ci, system-pwa-ci and continuity-guard protect runtime/schema/PWA behavior.

role_dispositions.destination: Reminder schedules become first-class reminder.scheduled events in system_events; no second reminder database owner is introduced.
Execution reminders do not create deadlines, expiry, Challenge semantics, penalties or reward changes.
Keep the existing delivery tables/pipeline, add richer provider diagnostics and feed it from the new execution-reminder engine.
Hard deadline/recommended-window behavior stays unchanged; a separate bounded execution-reminder engine handles explicit reminder.schedule events.
Existing Web Push receiving/click behavior remains the notification surface; player copy is updated to describe System push reminders rather than deadline-only reminders.
Ordinary quest reminder ownership is explicitly moved to System/PWA; the assistant-created ChatGPT quest reminder automation is disabled.
No destructive migration; all prior code and ledger history remain recoverable.
Add unit, PostgreSQL, HTTP smoke, PWA-copy and push-diagnostic guards for the end-to-end reminder path.

capability_probes.assertion: The PWA can still subscribe/unsubscribe devices with the existing VAPID public-key endpoint and service worker.
A System quest reminder must fire from the System server/event ledger without depending on a ChatGPT automation or an open PWA tab.
A scheduled reminder for a quest that becomes terminal before remind_at must not emit a notification or alter quest/reward state.
Prior push/deadline implementation and failed delivery evidence remain recoverable from Git/Neon history.

tests.expected: Execution reminder due/active/idempotency behavior, PostgreSQL schedule gate, push diagnostics and existing model tests PASS.

tests.command: system-cloud-ci PostgreSQL HTTP smoke + system-pwa-ci + continuity-guard
tests.expected: reminder.schedule is accepted only on PostgreSQL runtime, PWA reminder copy is present, existing Quest/Challenge/timing/push behavior remains green.

verification.base_head_diff: System runtime slice adds first-class reminder.scheduled ledger events, a PostgreSQL schedule gate, a server-side execution reminder engine, Web Push diagnostic preservation, PWA copy/capability updates, and end-to-end regression coverage. Timing v2, Challenge semantics, Quest rewards/lifecycle and player progress are unchanged. The assistant-created ChatGPT quest reminder automation is disabled.
verification.candidate_readback: Candidate CI passed model, PostgreSQL, Docker, PWA, LifeUp and continuity checks; HTTP smoke verified reminder.schedule is exposed only on PostgreSQL runtime and persists reminder.scheduled.
